To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the quality of feedback in an online peer feedback setting depends on the feedback perceptions of the participants.

(1) the quality of feedback is positively associated with the quality of feedback perceptions, (2) social presence affects the quality of feedback, (3) social presence is a complex construct that needs further validation.
feedback perceptions and feelings social presence are related to observed feedback, which is an important finding for online learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of feedback and feelings of social presences in online peer coaching for teachers in training.
the role of social presence and feedback in online learning.
the question how to enhance the feedback process and to increase social presence among teachers in online learning.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
feedback is an important factor for learning and that social presence is a crucial factor for feedback.
feedback is a social interaction process and that social presence is a relevant factor in this process.
the quality of online feedback is affected by social presence and that the quality of feedback is related to perceptions of feedback.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
feedback and social presence are interrelated and both are essential in online learning environments.
online feedback is a social interaction process that is influenced by social presence.
online peer coaching can be a valuable addition to teacher training programs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the feedback that students perceive to be given to them, is more effective than feedback that is given to them, but they do not perceive to be given.
the social interaction processes in feedback need to be studied more thoroughly, especially in online learning.
feedback should be conceptualized as a social interaction.
